## What this adds

Production plumbing: emails when leads arrive, stronger rate limits, and docs for deploying the app.

## Highlights

- Resend email templates and send helper
- Cron worker at `/api/internal/notify` (every 5 minutes on Vercel)
- Upstash Redis rate limiting with in-memory fallback for local dev
- `docs/deployment.md`, production seed script, updated environment example

## How to test

Create a booking or contact message, then run the notify endpoint with the cron secret. Confirm email delivery when Resend is configured.
